19565: Yui Hirasawa is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!. She's also the main protagonist. She is the air-headed lead guitarist and vocalist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time.
19566: Mio Akiyama is one of the five main characters in K-ON! She is a passionate and technical left-handed musician and writer who serves as the bassist, second vocalist and main lyricist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. She is a kind and warm girl, albeit very shy and sensitive.
19567: Ritsu Tainaka, called Ricchan by Tsumugi Kotobuki and Yui Hirasawa, is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!. She is the self-appointed president of the Light Music Club and the drummer of the band Ho-kago Tea Time.
19568: Tsumugi Kotobuki, otherwise known as Mugi is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON! She is a wealthy, cheery, cute girl with a gentle personality who plays the keyboard and is the main musical composer in the band Ho-kago Tea Time.
19569: Sawako is the adviser for the wind instrument club at Yui's school.
19570: Nodoka is Yui's childhood friend and confidant who is a member of the school's student council.
19571: Ui is Yui's younger sister, who begins the story as a third-year junior high school student, but later enters Yui's high school the following year in the same class as Azusa.
21173: Azusa Nakano, nicknamed "Azu-nyan" by Yui Hirasawa, is a main character in the K-ON! series. She is a second year student at Sakuragaoka High School.
23344: Megumi was the president of the student council before Nodoka succeeds her in her third year, and she is also the president of Mio's fan club. She stalks Mio during her last few days in high school because she wanted to see Mio one more time.
31525: Satoshi is Ritsu's younger brother. He appears when Ritsu is walking home with him from the movies. He then ventures of with a friend from school he saw on the way home. He seems to respect his sister Ritsu but still acts like a normal boy.
31526: Jun is Azusa's and Ui's classmate who often hangs out with the latter. Jun is generally a playful and easygoing girl, but she is sometimes rude without realizing it, compelling Azusa to reprimand her.
31618: She is a former member of the Light Music Club of Sakuragaoka High School and the manager of the live house where the Light Music Club were invited to perform.
33872: She is a friend of Sawako's from back when they were in high school, and they were both in the light music club together as part of the band Death Devil. She and Sawako used to try to outdo each other on the guitar. Her stage name is Christina.
67011: Yui and Ui's mother. She is usually away with their father so Ui is left to do all of the chores and take care of Yui.
67409: He is a classical literature teacher at Sakuragaoka High School. He has taught there for a long time, since he was the supervisor of the Light Music Club when the members of the band Death Devil (Norimi Kawaguchi, Sawako Yamanaka, Jane and Della) still attended school.
67937: Ichigo Wakaouji is one of Yui Hirasawa's classmates from class 3-2. She has long brown hair, styled in low twintails and eyebrow length bangs, and is a member of the Baton Club and an expert in it, able to teach the other members.
68163: Himeko Tachibana is one of the students from Class 3-2. Himeko is a member of the school's Softball Club and has a part-time job at a convenience store. Her behaviour is that of any other high school girl, but she has in fact a warm-hearted and polite side.
68165: Haruko Chikada is one of the students from Class 3-2 . She is a member of the school's jazz club. She has a kind personality, being very helpful and openhearted. She is able to sense the mood of the group extremely well and gets along with teachers too.
68167: Keiko Iida is one of the students from Class 3-2. Keiko is a member of the school's Basketball Club and a close friend of Ushio Oota and Nobuyo Nakajima. She loves to chat and gossip. Keiko follows every new fad and also goes to pop idols' concerts a lot.
68185: Youko Sasaki is one of the students from Class 3-2 She has been Yui's classmate since their first year in high school. She is a gentle and quiet girl, but when she becomes fixated on something, the world around her disappears.
71727: Mihoko's husband, who shares her love for rock and metal.
158315: An elderly woman in Yui's neighborhood. Yui likes to stop at her house to have tea. She is very kind and has been caring for Yui, Ui and Nodoka since kindergarten, often giving them any extra food that she has.
158621: A student in Class 3–2 at Sakuragaoka High School. Nobuyo is a member of her school's Basketball Club and is sports-oriented. She talks loudly and is often the one who stirs up excitement in class. She is sociable and friendly, a close friend of Ushio Oota and Keiko Iida.
158622: One of Yui, Mio, Tsumugi, and Ritsu's classmates in Class 3–2. She is normally quiet but can be frightening when she is angry. Her best friends are Natsuka and Nodoka.
158624: She is a very curious person and likes to gossip, just like Keiko.
158625: A former member of the Light Music Club, who was in the club at the same time as Sawako's band Death Devil. When she got married, she invited Death Devil to play at her wedding.
158626: One of Yui, Mio, Tsumugi, and Ritsu's classmates in Class 3–2. She is a member of the volleyball club together with her best friend Akane Satou. She is cheerful, tomboyish and very strong-willed. She also likes Buddhist statues and cola.
158627: One of Yui, Mio, Tsumugi, and Ritsu's classmates in Class 3–2 at Sakuragaoka High School. Akane is shy, and likes to follow the lead of her best friend Eri Taki, which is why she joined the volleyball club with her. She wants to be a cosmetologist after graduation.
158628: Chika is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. She is a cheerful girl who laughs a lot and is light on her feet. She's also a good friend of Mifuyu Matsumoto. She hates studying, though she is quick on the uptake.
158629: One of Yui, Mio, Tsumugi, and Ritsu's classmates in Class 3–2 at Sakuragaoka High School. She doesn't have a way with words and envies her classmates who do. Tsumugi sits in front of her, and she is amused to watch how pleased Tsumugi seems to be.
158630: One of Yui, Mio, Tsumugi, and Ritsu's classmates in Class 3–2. While she likes reading manga and photography and does things at her own pace, she is good at reading other people.
158633: Kimiko Makigami is one of the students from Class 3-2.She has a severe self-image complex and tries to avoid going near people with fair skin and slender legs.
160435: Ton-chan is a pig-nosed turtle that the Light Music Club keeps in the music room and serves as their ostensible mascot.
174310: Azu-nyan 2 is a cat that belongs to Jun Suzuki seen in Winter Days!. Her real name is not known, however, Azusa Nakano gave her the current nickname as an allusion to her own nickname (Azu-nyan).
174311: Hitomi Hoshino is an anime-only character that mainly appears in the episode Winter Days!. She is a worker at a fast food restaurant, where she helped Tsumugi Kotobuki as her senior.
174312: Saitō is a butler working for the Kotobuki household. He was never shown in the plot of either the manga nor the anime, but was heard on the phone sometimes.
174313: Della (stage name) is Death Devil's bassist and a former member of the Sakuragaoka High School's Light Music Club. Like her friends, Della highly cherishes her time within the Light Music Club and later their band Death Devil.
174314: Jane (stage name) is Death Devil's drummer and a former member of the Sakuragaoka High School's Light Music Club. Like her friends, Jane highly cherishes her time within the Light Music Club and later their band Death Devil.
174315: The Occult Club Members are two unnamed girls who are members of their school's Occult Club. They both appear to be calm and mysterious and have many interests in bizarre phenomena. They have, however, a helpful side and can also show gratitude by smiling.
174316: The Occult Club Members are two unnamed girls who are members of their school's Occult Club. They both appear to be calm and mysterious and have many interests in bizarre phenomena. They have, however, a helpful side and can also show gratitude by smiling.
174380: The Mio Fan Club Freshmen are two unnamed girls, who are members of the Mio Akiyama Fan Club. They first appeared in the episode Tea Party!
174381: The Mio Fan Club Freshmen are two unnamed girls, who are members of the Mio Akiyama Fan Club. They first appeared in the episode Tea Party!
174382: Yoji Okiyama is the headmaster of the Sakuragaoka High School and usually holds official speeches, where he wishes the senior students good luck for the future.
174813: Mika Saeki is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Mika is a member of the school's Volleyball club where she plays setter. She's also popular among girls because of her down-to-earth personality.
174814: Maki Wajima is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Maki is a part of the school's Volleyball Club and friends with all of its members.
174815: Kyouko Shimizu is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Kyouko is quiet and gentle while the expression on her face doesn't often change that much. She likes flowers. She also seems to know a lot about award ceremonies and the music they use.
174816: Masumi Yada is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Masumi is a close friend of Ai Tsuchiya, Toshimi Shibaya and Tsukasa Koiso. When the four of them gather together, they usually get pretty noisy.
174817: Haruna Okada is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Haruna has a refreshing personality and is a close friend of Keiko Sano. She does karaoke to relieve stress and can be easily influenced by others' moods.
174818: Ai Tsuchiya is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Ai is a close friend of Masumi Yada, Toshimi Shibaya and Tsukasa Koiso. When the four of them gather together, they usually get pretty noisy.
174819: Tae Kikuchi is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Tae worries about people seeing her as chubby because of her round face, even though she is slim in general. She is the type that accepts whatever comes.
174820: Natsuka Sakurai is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Natsuka is smart, sensible and helps others a lot. She is a good friend of Fūko Takahashi and is called "Nacchan" by others.
174821: Akiyo Miyamoto is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Akiyo is a reserved girl who does not talk much and who likes hanging out at the school's library due to her liking for books.
174822: Yoshimi Sunahara is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Yoshimi is a quiet, individualistic girl but when other people talk to her, she responds with a smile. She wants to study dressmaking after she graduates from high school.
174823: Toshimi Shibaya is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Toshimi is usually quiet but also gets loud when excited. She is a good friend of Masumi Yada, Ai Tsuchiya and Tsukasa Koiso.
174824: Toshimi Nakanishi is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Toshimi is a part of the school's Volleyball Club and friends with all of its members.
174825: Mifuyu Matsumoto is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Mifuyu is considered to be the older sister of the class and is a level-headed and reliable, but also delicate girl. Her hobby is handicrafts and she is a good friend of Chika Nojima.
174826: Kazuko Miura is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime.
174827: Hideko Sakuma is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Hideko is called "Mom" by others because she looks always calm and composed. She is kind and gentle and often lets people see her homework.
174828: Fumie Kimura is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime.Fumie has been Yui's classmate in at least their first and third year of high school.
174829: Tsukasa Koiso is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Tsukasa loves gossip and admires her classmate Himeko Tachibana. She has a lot of superficial knowledge about sex. She is a close friend of Masumi Yada, Ai Tsuchiya and Toshimi Shibaya.
174830: Michiko Endō is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Michiko appears to be girly, but can change suddenly to show a boyish side. She is a hard worker.
174831: Keiko Sano is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Keiko is optimistic and cheerful and does not let herself get too stressed out. She is a close friend of Haruna Okada and grew up with Shizuka Kinoshita.
181560: Shihois the guitarist and one of the vocalists of the band Love Crysis. Shiho and her bandmembers Maki and Aya invite the band of Maki's friend Ritsu Tainaka, Ho-kago Tea Time, to play at a live house as the first live performance outside of the band's school.
